title: Military members saw football-field-size triangular craft

tellings.quote: I remember sort of interviewing some military members that saw some really profound stuff like, you know, large, you know, triangular crafts, you know, football field size that, you know, hovered over them.

plain: Some US military members say that on their drive to work they saw huge triangular craft, the size of a football field, hovering right over them. David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who later became a whistleblower, tells Michels he interviewed these people himself while looking into such reports. He calls what they saw "some really profound stuff."
